title: Anagram groups
statement:
Two words are anagrams when one is a rearrangement of the letters of the other ("listen" and "silent"). Group a list of words into anagram groups.

Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 1000). The second line holds n distinct words separated by spaces; each word has 1 to 20 lowercase letters a-z.
Output: one line per group. Inside a group, print its words in alphabetical order separated by single spaces. Print the groups ordered by their first (alphabetically smallest) word. A word with no anagram in the list is a group of its own.

Example
Input:
6
silent tea listen eat enlist cat
Output:
cat
eat tea
enlist listen silent
